Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Corduroy & Velvet Throw Pillow, 24"W x 12"H, Black / Grey
Colors: Black/Grey
Made in the United States and imported Soft black corduroy has subtle metallic accents that bring a luxe look to your space, with grey velvet on the back for design versatility and added comfort. Hidden zipper at bottom of pillow. 24"L x 12”W Corduroy and velvet pillow cover with insert. Spot clean as needed. Pillow insert arrives in vacuum-sealed bag. Carefully remove insert from packaging. and let it fully expand before putting inside of pillow cover.
